name: Circuit breakers and disconnects
summary: Resettable switches that cut power on overload or fault: panel breakers, DC breakers and big isolator switches.
uses: Main isolator between a battery and an inverter
Resettable protection for a workshop circuit
identify: Clip-on modules in house panels marked with amps (10–63A); DC breakers say DC or show + and −. Rotary disconnects sit beside solar arrays, AC units and machines. Only use DC-rated breakers on DC, and test a panel before touching: solar or a generator can keep it live.
test: On continuity, a breaker should read near 0 Ω when on and open when off. The handle should snap firmly between positions.

decay.note: Breakers last decades in a dry panel.
